title: 009 逻辑没问题010 血条这么短
content_zh:
沈知迟疑：“来了个……波斯？”
“不是波斯，是BOSS！”张泱纠正他口音。“啧，血条挺雄厚，不好搞哦。”
“……你打不过？”沈知不懂什么是血条，注意力全在后面那句“不好搞”上。
说完，他自己先怔愣住。
明明他最清楚这位贵人有多扶不上墙，怎么会下意识以为她能应付棘手的敌人？
不待他羞恼懊悔，张泱嘁了声。
“你在说什么屁话？”
一个破游戏运营十六年，自然不可能没有版本更迭和开放新等级上限。从刚开服的十级上限，如今满级一百五，玩家成长速度飞快。
跟玩家对抗接触的PC自然也不能落下，他们会随着剧情推进而成长，各方面数据得到各种强化，但只有参与剧情的有这福利。
剧情外的PC可没有。
张泱自然是主线外的普通PC。
要是主线内的重要PC，哪里能伪装玩家，自由逍遥这么多年？她这些年没有露出马脚，没被她暗中观察接触的人类样本发现端倪，自然不是这些观察样本不行，而是她张泱太行了！一边观察一边模仿，举止言行混在玩家堆看不出一点儿反常之处。
“来的BOSS血条再厚又如何？”只要有血条，那就是能被杀的目标！她张泱惜命不假，却不是为了保命就让自己不痛快！
混乱之中，一声马蹄格外清晰。
“你是要与我军公然为敌？”
阵中传来一道威严浑厚的声音。
斜乜那些被金币勾走魂，只顾着争抢而不顾军纪的一众武卒，来人没刻意压制威势，仅是一声冷哼，爆发的气浪便叫这些人吹得人仰马翻一片惨叫：“你是何人？”
无头人侧身面向对方。
没有头，自然也不可能出声回应。
但“祂”挡在来人路径之上，而“祂”身后正是仓惶逃跑的俘虏，态度很明确。

“你不肯让开？”来人仿佛不在乎这批俘虏跑不跑，注意力全在这个突然杀出的无头人身上，面甲下的双眸从认真转为戏谑，“行，有胆量！不过我要是这样，你待如何？”
举刀冲向俘虏逃窜的方向。
军阵后方倏忽响起一阵节奏强过一阵，似能强迫心脏也共振的恐怖鼓声，四肢百骸的血液被强行催热。刚刚还被金币迷花眼的武卒在鼓声响起的瞬间，一个个四肢僵硬，搂到手中的金币哗啦啦掉一地也没注意。当他们半抬起头，本该漆黑的眸子猩红如血。
张泱“咦”了声。
“这是什么辅助技能？”
张泱不清楚状况，但沈知却再了解不过，他现在甚至对这种鼓声产生了极大的心理阴影：“这个鼓声会让那些武卒变得无畏无惧，脑中只剩冲锋陷阵的冲动勇气。”
自然也不会再受金币的腐蚀。
下方，无头人在风沙中屹立不倒。
与那一声威严浑厚的“杀”一同倾泻而出的，还有无头人手中那块金砖。山上的沈知捏紧了拳头，没想到身侧这位贵人如此莽撞冲动，但他很快就顾不上担心张泱。
看清下方局势，目眦欲裂。
“尔敢！”无头人持金砖杀向主将面门，而受主将军令的兵卒却如两道奔涌洪流向俘虏逃窜的方向追去。此举能是什么意思？
沈知心知肚明！
金属碰撞声音伴随着喷溅火花。
主将没料到无头人的力气如此之大，错估之下也吃了个小小的暗亏。不过，面甲下如鹰隼般锐利的双眸却无气愤，有的只是讥嘲。
“记住，这些人可是你害死的！”
沈知的声音恨到颤抖。
content_en:
Shen Zhi hesitated: "Is there...Persia?"
"It's not Persia, it's BOSS!" Zhang Yang corrected his accent. "Tsk, the health bar is quite strong, it's not easy to deal with."
"...You can't beat him?" Shen Zhizhi didn't understand what a health bar was, so his attention was focused on the last sentence "It's not easy to deal with."
After saying that, he was stunned for a moment.
Obviously he knew best how little this noble lady could stand up to the wall, so how could he subconsciously think that she could deal with such a difficult enemy?
Before he could feel ashamed and regretful, Zhang Yang groaned.
"What the hell are you talking about?"
A broken game has been in operation for sixteen years, and it is naturally impossible that there will be no version changes and new level caps. From the level limit of ten when the server was first launched to the full level of one hundred and fifty, players are growing rapidly.
Naturally, the PCs who come into contact with players cannot be left behind. They will grow as the plot progresses, and their data in various aspects will be enhanced in various ways. However, only those who participate in the plot will have this benefit.
There is no PC outside the plot.
Zhang Yang is naturally an ordinary PC outside the main line.
If he is an important PC in the main line, how can he pretend to be a player and live freely for so many years? She has not shown any clues in these years, and no clues have been discovered by the human samples she has secretly observed and contacted. Naturally, it is not that these observation samples are not good, but that she, Zhang Yang, is so good! Observing and imitating at the same time, his behavior, words and deeds were mixed among the players, and there was nothing unusual about him.
"It doesn't matter how thick the health bar of the BOSS is?" As long as it has a health bar, it is a target that can be killed! She cherished her life, but she didn't make herself unhappy just to save her life!
In the chaos, the sound of a horse's hoof was particularly clear.
"Are you going to be an open enemy of our army?"
A majestic and rich voice came from the formation.
Looking at the soldiers whose souls had been lured away by the gold coins, who were only focused on fighting and regardless of military discipline, the newcomer did not deliberately suppress their power. He just snorted coldly, and the burst of air made these people scream in agony: "Who are you?"
The headless men turned sideways and faced each other.
Without a head, it is naturally impossible to respond.
But "He" was blocking the path of the incoming person, and behind "He" were the prisoners who were running away in panic. His attitude was very clear.
"You won't let go?" The visitor seemed not to care whether these prisoners escaped or not. His attention was entirely on the headless man who suddenly appeared. The eyes under the visor changed from serious to joking, "Okay, you have the courage! But if I do this, how will you treat me?"
He raised his knife and rushed towards the direction in which the prisoners were fleeing.
A terrifying drum sound suddenly sounded from behind the military formation. The rhythm was stronger than before, and it seemed to force the heart to resonate. The blood in the limbs was forcibly heated. The soldiers, who were dazzled by the gold coins just now, stiffened their limbs when the drums sounded, and the gold coins in their hands fell to the ground without paying attention. When they half raised their heads, their dark eyes were as red as blood.
Zhang Yang said "Huh".
"What kind of auxiliary skill is this?"
Zhang Yang didn't know the situation, but Shen Zhi understood it all too well. He even had a great psychological shadow on this kind of drum sound now: "This drum sound will make those soldiers fearless, and only the impulsive courage to charge into battle will be left in their minds."
Naturally, it will no longer be corroded by gold coins.
Below, a headless man stood firm in the wind and sand.
Along with that majestic and powerful "kill" sound, there was also the gold brick in the headless man's hand. Shen Zhi clenched his fists on the mountain. He didn't expect the noble man next to him to be so reckless and impulsive, but he soon stopped worrying about Zhang Yang.
Seeing the situation below clearly, his eyes were about to burst.
"How dare you!" The headless man held a gold brick and charged towards the general's front door, while the soldiers who had been ordered by the general were chasing after the prisoners in the direction of their escape like two surging torrents. What could this move mean?
Shen Zhi knows it well!
The sound of metal colliding was accompanied by flying sparks.
The general did not expect that the headless man was so powerful, and suffered a small loss due to his miscalculation. However, the sharp eyes like falcons under the visor were not angry, but only mocking."Remember, you killed these people!"
Shen Zhi's voice trembled with hatred.
